messages:
Jonah (AE): Quick handoff for Cascade — signed 1yr committed, seat count 50. Need: SSO (Okta, SAML 2.0), Private (VPC) deployment in eu-west-1, Dedicated GPU pool (8xA10G equiv) with autoscale, data residency EU. Target kickoff: Wed Mar 31 10:00 UTC. Primary contacts: Sophie (IT, sophie@cascade.com), Marco (Eng, marco@cascade.com). Sales notes: https://redwood.sales/notes/cascade-1978 :thumbsup:

Maya (CSM): Thanks @Jonah — I'll own onboarding. Wed 10:00 UTC works. I'll create onboarding playbook and invite Sophie/Marco. Can you drop any SAML metadata and contract ID here?

Jonah (AE): Contract ID: CSD-1978-001. SAML metadata attached in link: https://files.redwood/okta/cascade-metadata.xml

Elena (Solutions Eng): Re: infra + model plan — recommend starting with rwi-7b-quant for throughput, switch to rwi-13b if quality regressions appear. Need customer to open port for our deployment agent and provide a service account with VPC peering details. Minimal checklist:
```
- SAML metadata (IdP).
- Service account + key (uploads to secure bucket).
- VPC CIDR & peering approval.
- Allowlist outbound egress to 52.23.11.0/24.
```
I'll draft a runbook and post it in the kickoff channel.

Pranav (Support Eng): I'll spin up a support ticket (INT-4532) and tag as priority-high for the first 30 days. Please include expected QPS and typical sequence lengths — that determines batching/slotting. Also add me to the kickoff invite.

Maya (CSM): Expected baseline QPS ~15, peak ~70 during initial syncs. Sequences mostly short (<= 512 tokens) except for internal search trials. Adding @Pranav to invite.

Elena (Solutions Eng): FYI, for Private deployment we need customer to approve HSM/KMS integration if they want key separation. Flagging for compliance.

Jonah (AE): Sophie already requested KMS separation. She'll share KMS ARN during kickoff.

Maya (CSM): Next steps I have:
- Create onboarding calendar invite (Wed Mar 31 10:00 UTC) — owner: Maya
- Share SAML metadata + contract ID — owner: Jonah
- Draft infra runbook & model recommendation — owner: Elena
- Create support ticket & escalation path — owner: Pranav
- Pre-kickoff questionnaire to Sophie/Marco — owner: Maya
I'll update this thread after invites sent. :white_check_mark:

Pranav (Support Eng): Noted. I'll prepare a quick escalation playbook and a Slack P1 channel template: #p1-cascade. Will post link to INT-4532 once created.

Maya (CSM): Thanks team. If any blockers before EOD Tue, drop them here. Otherwise I'll proceed with invites and docs. :rocket:
